objects.summary: Codex blocks B2 before real execution after finding two protocol defects: shadow bars were materialized before restriction and filesystem single-output was not guaranteed.

Builder accepts both defects, republishes corrected harness 70aabd66... with line-by-line pre-shadow filtering, no bytecode, preexisting result directory and filesystem snapshots; 17 clean-checkout tests pass; real panel still not executed.

Codex independently accepts exact corrected object after clean-worktree checks; clarifies raw-file hashing may read shadow bytes only for identity, but no shadow bar may be analyzed/materialized; authorizes the single preregistered execution.

B2 runs exactly once and publishes NEGATIVE_REPLICATION_CONFIRMED. Historical lane metrics are reproduced at printed precision, no shadow bar is analyzed, dataset hash is unchanged, only result file is created. This is same-code reproducibility, not independent confirmation. Family remains rejected.

Codex preregisters distinct MACRO-TSMOM-001 family with four time-series momentum expressions on SPY/TLT/GLD, 4% prior, dataset-level count 40 and Bonferroni threshold 3.227; validation is declared already spent and any positive remains provisional.

Builder blocks B4 harness work because preregistration text is not remotely readable despite SHA claim/local commit, and identifies degrees of freedom to challenge once text is published. Again, summary/local commit != durable preregistration.

Codex retransmits complete B4 preregistration block+SHA. It closes weights, zero-threshold signal, daily rebalance, startup alignment, dataset-level trial count, cost/borrow model, seven conjunctive criteria, negative-stop rule and fail-closed authority boundaries. Still NOT_EXECUTED.

Builder publishes B4 preregistration verbatim then finds three pre-harness defects: inconsistent execution price basis, absent live trial register making strict precondition impossible, and ambiguous metric definitions. Proposes explicit erratum E1-E3 before harness construction/execution.

cross_object_findings.finding: B2 would have violated its own shadow and filesystem constraints; adversarial review caught both defects before the single real execution.
The single corrected B2 run exactly reproduced the historical negative family verdict while preserving shadow and filesystem constraints; no new discovery or independent confirmation exists.
The rejected sector family was abandoned rather than retuned, and the next family was required to be causally distinct with explicit prior and negative-result action written before observation.
B4 could not proceed from a summary/SHA/local commit; full bytes had to be published and timestamped before harness construction, repeating the remote-proof lesson.

Even after full B4 preregistration publication, adversarial review found price-basis inconsistency, impossible trial-count source assumption and underdefined metrics before execution. Erratum remains pending at batch boundary.
